title: Canary and blue-green inside the cluster

videos.script: A rolling update replaces every copy, and a mistake in the new version reaches every user before anyone notices. {{rolling}} Two older ideas limit the damage. A canary sends a small share of real traffic to the new version, and the rest stays on the old one until the new one has proved itself. {{canary}} Blue-green runs both versions in full and moves all traffic from one to the other in a single step, and back just as fast. {{bluegreen}} Neither needs a special tool. You will build both with what the cluster already has: two Deployments, a route with weights, and a Service selector. {{plan}}
